drums.tags: Funk rock instrumental. An electric bass guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using slap and pop techniques, emphasizing the root and octave with chromatic passing tones. A clean electric guitar performs rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords on the off-beats. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a tight, dry snare sound and a consistent kick drum pattern. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement focuses on the interplay between the bass melody and the rhythmic guitar scratching.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap bass riff begins, dry drum kit enters with steady kick and snare]

[Main Section]
[clean electric guitar enters with rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords]
[bass continues syncopated slap and pop pattern with chromatic slides]
[drums maintain consistent backbeat]
